sanskrit: salilaṃ salilecchūnāṃ chatraṃ chāyāmapīcchatām | vyajanaṃ vyajanecchūnā vaiśākhe māsi bhūmipa || 17 || jalaṃ chatraṃ ca vyajanaṃ dānaṃ yeṣāṃ viśiṣyate | mādhave māsi saṃprāpte brāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine || 18 || adattvodakakumbhaṃ ca cātako jāyate bhuvi || 19 ||
english: 17-19. Water should be given to those who wish for it. An umbrella should be given to those who desire shade. In the month of Vaiśākha, O king, fans should be given to those who wish for fans. At the advent of the month of Vaiśākha, water, umbrella and fan should be given to a Brāhmaṇa householder. The gift of these articles is (considered) excellent. By not giving a waterpot, one is reborn as a Cātaka bird (who depends on rainfall for drinking water).
